environment.frontend: Vite local application; automated source and behavior contracts
environment.database: Local SQLite development database plus isolated SQLite integration databases

productIdentity.reservation: soft-deleted products and inactive selling units retain their codes
productIdentity.internalDefaultRule: product and default-selling-unit barcode/SKU may mirror one logical default owner; alternate physical packs may not reuse it
productIdentity.concurrency: per-shop in-process decision serialization plus PostgreSQL Shop row FOR UPDATE across instances
productIdentity.offline: create and edit reject a conflicting product or pack code before IndexedDB product, local audit or sync-outbox writes

billingScan.catalogueScope: exact code lookup spans the complete catalogue, independent of category/filter limits
billingScan.packResolution: an active alternate selling-unit barcode or SKU returns both the product and exact selling unit
billingScan.cart: the exact selling unit survives search selection, optional configurator work and cart key/pricing resolution
billingScan.inactivePack: not sellable when its retired code is scanned
billingScan.unknownCode: continues into capture-on-first-scan instead of adding an arbitrary sole row

mobileUx.surface: full-width 100dvh product task panel on phones
mobileUx.keyboard: visual-keyboard inset path plus interactive-widget resizes-content support
mobileUx.touchTargets: compact inputs, selects and buttons use h-11; small text actions use the shared 44px tap-target overlay; keep-open label is min-h-11
mobileUx.freshAuthenticatedScreenCapture: not claimed; browser credential/PIN entry was avoided

liveDiscoveredRegression.symptom: the first proof's immediate code-free create returned 500 after Prisma's SQLite library engine panicked and closed the interactive transaction
liveDiscoveredRegression.cause: product and selling-unit namespace reads were launched with Promise.all inside one interactive transaction connection
liveDiscoveredRegression.fix: namespace reads are sequential inside the transaction; PostgreSQL's shop-row lock remains held across both reads and the write
liveDiscoveredRegression.regression: a packed-code product followed immediately by a code-free product now succeeds in the isolated integration suite
liveDiscoveredRegression.runtimeRecovery: main and integration Prisma clients were regenerated before the successful live rerun

scope: Local correctness and production-readiness evidence. It does not claim fresh authenticated screenshots, exact-candidate CI, external deployment or human release approval. Synthetic records were confined to the local QA database; a concurrently running local QA reset invalidated the cleanup session after proof.
